nodes.title: Escrow and closing working group
nodes.alt: People at a table with floor plans and a peer-to-peer property deal sketch
nodes.proof: Attendance notes and the public working-group agenda.
nodes.story: Sat with closing clerks and builders to map a peer-to-peer deal: list, deposit, inspect, hand over, release funds.

nodes.title: Property escrow contract PR
nodes.alt: Laptop showing a property escrow contract pull request
nodes.proof: A public pull request: deposit, inspection window, release to seller.
nodes.story: Wrote the contract that holds buyer funds until inspection and handover. A stranger can inspect the PR and read the rules.

nodes.title: Testnet P2P listing
nodes.alt: Phone showing a peer-to-peer property listing with a lock-deposit action
nodes.proof: A testnet listing and a lock-deposit transaction.
nodes.story: The working group and the escrow PR made a test listing possible: a house, a deposit button, no platform as middleman.

nodes.title: Live P2P fulfillment
nodes.alt: Keys and a tablet showing fulfillment complete
nodes.proof: A mainnet fulfillment transaction and a recorded key handover.
nodes.story: A real deal completed: deposit locked, inspection passed, keys handed over, funds released.

nodes.title: Listing and handover UX
nodes.alt: Paper wireframes of a property listing and fulfillment steps
nodes.proof: Wireframes for listing, deposit, inspection, and handover.
nodes.story: The same fulfillment also left a listing and handover design a merchant or buyer can follow.

nodes.title: Clerk at live closings
nodes.alt: A desk of closing folders, a stamp, and a house key
nodes.proof: Closing files and a public log of which deals the clerk sat.
nodes.story: Sat the desk at live closings: escrow, keys. The map of a deal came from the room, not from a course.

nodes.title: Live P2P fulfillment, on site
nodes.alt: Keys handed over at a house door, tablet in hand
nodes.proof: A mainnet fulfillment transaction and a recorded key handover.
nodes.story: Ran a real peer-to-peer deal on site: deposit locked, inspection passed, keys handed over, funds released. Did not write the contract.

nodes.title: Second live fulfillment
nodes.alt: Keys handed over on a brick townhouse stoop
nodes.proof: A second mainnet fulfillment on a different property.
nodes.story: A second real deal, a different house. Not a one-off.
